title: Black Clover
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where everyone has magic, the orphan Asta is born without any but wields anti-magic swords from a rare five-leaf grimoire. He and his rival Yuno, a magical prodigy, join the Magic Knights and work toward becoming the Wizard King while fighting enemies who seek to unleash devils.
life_message: It holds up never giving up, whatever you were born with.

content.note: Frequent magic battles (Wikipedia; level to verify).
Devils and dark magic threats (to verify).
